prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: third high-fidelity compositional option for a desktop Thai administrative web app, 1440x1000 landscape
Primary request: Same indexed-evidence-registry visual world for a Thai university planning, budget, project, quarterly disbursement, EdPEx and AUN-QA system, but test a lifecycle-spine composition centered on traceability.
Composition/framing: compact white top bar; burnt-orange numbered index rail on the left. A bold vertical lifecycle spine occupies the first quarter of the content area with five fixed stages: คำของบ, อนุมัติ, โครงการ, เบิกจ่าย, KPI; each stage shows count, total, and exception marker in a strict registry line, not cards. The selected stage opens into a wide central action ledger with Thai project rows and direct approve/revise actions. A narrow lower band connects the selected row across Q1-Q4 using plan-versus-actual cells. On the right, a persistent evidence docket shows the selected record’s owner, budget, progress, KPI links, and attachments. The memorable moment is one orange trace line visibly connecting a selected record through all five lifecycle stages.
Style/medium: polished production-grade SaaS UI mockup, crisp flat white surfaces, archival index typography, ledger rules, small square corners, tabular numerals, high density with controlled quiet.
Color palette: burnt orange #C2410C, vivid orange #EA580C, warm white #FFF9F5, pure white, ink charcoal #292524, dark green #166534, amber/red only for state.
Materials/textures: digital registry spine, index marks, ledger lines; no paper photograph or texture.
Text: Thai-first interface labels for the system, traceable lifecycle, decision queue, evidence docket and Q1-Q4.
Constraints: executive and coordinator usefulness; accessible; explicit labels plus color; no logo invention; no browser chrome; show realistic sample data.
Avoid: kanban cards, generic four KPI cards, gradients, glassmorphism, rounded card mosaic, purple or blue branding, dark mode, decorative illustration, unlabeled charts.
